sources.entry: solidtime - Modern time tracking application for freelancers and agencies. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: solidtime is an open-source time tracking application aimed at freelancers and agencies, listed on awesome-selfhosted under Time Tracking.
summary.what_it_does: solidtime provides time tracking with a web interface for logging hours against projects and tasks. It supports managing projects with members, tasks assigned to projects, and clients linked to projects. Billable rates can be set at the project, project-member, organization-member, and organization levels. One account can manage multiple organizations, with roles and permissions for organization members. The README also says time data can be imported from Toggl, Clockify, and Timeentry CSV files. Self-hosting guides and an examples repository are linked, and a hosted cloud version is offered as an alternative.
use_cases: track billable hours for client work
run time tracking for an agency with multiple clients
migrate time entries from Toggl or Clockify
self-host a time tracker for a team
set billing rates per project or team member
how_to_run: Follow the self-hosting guides linked in the README (the README does not include install commands itself)
notable: Import from Toggl, Clockify, and Timeentry CSV
Billable rates at project, member, and organization levels
caveats: Self-hosting requires following external guides; setup steps are not in the README
Pull requests from unvouched authors are closed automatically unless they change 50 lines or fewer, and contributors must discuss changes first
